desc: Graph/mapping formulation over the 26 letters: required map f from each S letter to its T letter; same source with different targets → -1.
Feasibility: conflict case → -1; and the dS==26 & dT==26 & S!=T case → -1 (permutation, first op drops distinct count from 26).

Min-op rule: E (#distinct moved source letters) + P (#cycles whose every node has in-degree exactly 1, i.e. "pure" cycles); tree-into-cycle is free; one spare/freed label is reused for all pure cycles.
Implement the Python solution reading stdin and writing the answer to stdout.
Test on all 4 public samples (all PASSED), including sample 3 conflict → -1 and sample 4 (E=3, P=1 → 4).
Brute-force BFS verification on small alphabets (tree-into-cycle, disjoint swaps, deep tree, non-injective 26-letter cases) — no mismatches vs E+P and the -1 rule.
